start: First day of the indenture! Forty years to freedom, and only a whole moon to colonize. Easy.
sector_1: Outpost one, staked! The company will be so proud. They won't be, but they could be.
sector_2: Another sector colonized. I'm basically a pioneer. A pioneer who isn't paid.
sector_3: Look at me, taming the frontier. The frontier does not appear to consent.
sector_4: Colony's spreading nicely. The brochure said 'adventure'. It did not say 'this'.
sector_5: Halfway across the mare and still alive. Mum said I'd amount to nothing. Partial credit.
sector_6: Progress! At this rate I'll be free by the time I'm ancient and bitter.
mine_good: Ooh, shiny! The company takes ninety percent, but the other ten is basically mine.
More ore! Every crystal is one atom closer to freedom.
Cha-ching. Well, not for me, but somebody's getting rich.
Load's looking good. Almost worth the crushing existential dread.
anger_1: Hello? Did I dig up someone's garden? They seem a bit cross.
anger_2: Okay, the locals are officially annoyed. In my defence, the ore was just lying there.
anger_3: Right, they're furious now. Turns out the moon was inhabited. Nobody tells me anything.
anger_max: They are LIVID. I have single-handedly started an interplanetary incident. On day one.
ufo: Incoming saucer! I'm sure they only want to talk. They're dropping something. Not talk.
Oh good, the neighbours. Angry, glowing, and armed. Standard.
A flying disc, for me? You really shouldn't have. Please leave.
ufo_peaceful: Oh, hello! The locals have ships. They're just... watching me. Waving, even. What lovely, non-threatening neighbours.
jump_far: Weeeee! Low gravity is the one genuine perk of indentured servitude.
close_call: That was close. My hull insurance has a very unkind excess.
death_1: Ow. That's coming out of my wages. All of it, probably.
death_2: Well, that's the lander dented. And me. Mostly me.
power_up: A gadget! Finally, something in this job that isn't trying to kill me.
one_up: A spare rig! The company must like me. The company likes no one.
game_over: Contract terminated. And after all that unpaid enthusiasm. Typical.
Contract terminated. The locals were chanting something about 'next time' and 'your skies'. Probably nothing.
Shift's over. The natives kept pointing up at the stars and then at me. Friendly lot. I'm sure it's fine.
hiscore: A personal best! Nobody will ever know or care, but I'll know. That's something.
speed_up: Flooring it! What could possibly go wrong on an unpaved alien moon?
